title: snack config get payload
description: The `data` of a `snack config get --json` document. `key` is null when the whole configuration was asked for. Frozen at 0.9: a field here does not disappear or change meaning without a major release, and a consumer must tolerate fields added by a later minor.

value.description: The configuration, or the value at `key`. Its own schema is published as config.schema.json.
